Paolo Ruffini publicó su método en 1804,: Paolo Ruffini published his method in 1804, in the same work in which he tried to prove that there is no formula for fifth-degree equations. The proof had a gap and the mathematical community ignored it; Ruffini himself died without seeing his insight recognised. Abel completed it twenty years later and today the result carries both their names. Of that misunderstood work only the small part survives in classrooms: the scheme for dividing.

Ruffini no es un truco de examen: es el: Ruffini's rule is not an exam trick: it is the algorithm calculators and drawing programs use to evaluate polynomials quickly, and there it is called Horner's method. When a video game draws a smooth curve, it is evaluating polynomials thousands of times a second, and that saving is the difference between running smoothly and stuttering.
